title: Safe Apply & Rollback Lifecycle for Batching/Cache Recommendations
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Problem: Customers are reluctant to accept automated batching and KV-cache recommendations because of potential latency regressions or functional edge-cases. Goal: design a conservative, auditable apply/rollback flow in the Optimize console that lets operators preview diffs, stage safe rollouts (canary + verification), and inspect a complete immutable audit trail of what was applied and why. This ticket scopes the PM spec and acceptance criteria for recommendation cards, diff preview modal, staged apply controls, and an apply-history UI (chronological ledger with links to telemetry and PRs). The solution must: 1) Surface the expected cost delta and estimated latency/throughput impact; 2) Provide a visual diff at config level (batch size, cache TTL, keying heuristics, model-variant mapping); 3) Provide one-click dry-run and simulated metrics; 4) Offer canary gates with automatic rollback triggers tied to telemetry; 5) Record an immutable audit event with user, timestamp, config delta, and links to observability traces and dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation card includes clear CTA: Preview Diff, Dry-run, Apply (Stage/Immediate)
Diff preview shows per-field before/after values with inline rationale and risk score
Dry-run triggers a simulation job that returns synthetic latency/cost estimates within 10 minutes
Staged apply supports percentage-based canary (e.g., 5%, 25%, 100%) with automatic rollback on SLO breach rules
Apply-history lists all applies with user, timestamp, delta summary, linked telemetry, and an exportable JSON snapshot
Audit trail entries are immutable and include arbitrary operator notes and a link to the originating recommendation
UI has guardrails for high-risk changes (P0/High customer impact) requiring explicit confirmation and optional approval from an SRE or Security reviewer
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (beta internal): implement recommendation card preview + immutable apply event (console-2026.03). Phase 2 (canary orchestration): staged apply + auto-rollback hooks with templated SLO rules (runtime-1.22). Phase 3 (GA): exportable audit reports, RBAC controls for apply/approve, and cross-tenant summaries for accounts with multiple projects.
